note: These evals target the /audit-a11y dynamic workflow (.claude/workflows/audit-a11y.js), not a skill — the run-evals.sh skill harness does not apply. Run with: bash .claude/workflows/evals/run-workflow-evals.sh audit-a11y, then grade with grade-workflow-eval.sh. In environments without the native workflow runner (e.g. headless claude -p without the Dynamic workflows toggle), the session emulates the script — the evals still grade end-to-end output, but not the workflow runtime itself.

evals.description: ToolCallCard + AgentStatus violation fixtures in place — tests recall across two violated components and that verification does not reject real findings
